stateDetail: No order is live. Gold is inside the bounce. NAS100 is outside its only window.

macro.realYieldWhy: Gold pays nothing. The 10-year TIPS yield is the carry given up to hold it. The short-or-flat rule is on only at or above 1.5%. Today is almost double that.
macro.dxyWhy: Gold is priced in dollars. A firm dollar near 102.1, under Monday's 102.54 high, means more dollars to bid the same ounce. Yield under 1.5%, or gold holding above 4215, is what flips the book. Neither is here.

gold.note: Do not add to a short in the bounce. Short or flat only while real yield is at or above 1.5% and price is under 4170-4215.

rules: No gold short while price is still inside the bounce. 4105 must go first.
